## 1. Standard Pay Scales  
[ Swamy's CCS (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016 and Swamy's FR & SR, Part-I General Rules]  
On the recommendation of the Seventh Pay Commission, the existing system of Pay Bands and Grade Pay has been dispensed with and new functional levels have been arrived at by merging the Grade Pay with the pay in the Pay Band.
